summary: The implementation contains strong fail-closed calibration and provenance mechanisms, including Leica XML parsing, manifest-locked XML hashes, ordered source manifests, mask/checkpoint copies, and calibration-before-measurement ordering. Acceptance is nevertheless blocked because the retained RC4 evidence does not reproduce those provenance records and its recorded pipeline/profile SHA-256 values disagree with the reviewed working-tree files. The archived study manifest also omits Leica XML hashes, preventing independent verification of the authoritative organized-filename-to-XML mapping.

findings.title: RC4 manifests do not match the reviewed pipeline and profile hashes
findings.impact: The retained visual and replay evidence cannot be cryptographically attributed to the pipeline and production profile present at the reviewed commit. This breaks the required commit-bound provenance chain even though the checkpoint file itself matches its declared hash.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json records pipeline d3933b25... and profile 3620551c....
audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/tracking/tracking_replay_manifest.json records the same hashes.
Required-environment hash command returned pipeline fbec09d7... and profile ff81aa0c.... for the reviewed working tree.
git diff --name-status 3a62520... 366fc22... showed no intervening pipeline/profile modification.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate or correct the acceptance evidence from a clean checkout of reviewed commit 366fc22eb53df812dd3f162eb26cdbab46b66b61. Record hashes computed from the exact files used and automatically verify every manifest hash against the candidate before opening the audit gate.

findings.title: Authoritative Leica mapping is retained without XML hashes
findings.impact: Organized specimen names may not identify their Leica acquisition. Without the XML digest, a reviewer cannot prove that each specimen's physical calibration came from the same metadata file validated during discovery, or detect later replacement by stale metadata.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/report/02_quality_control/source_files/study_manifest.csv omits calibration_metadata_sha256 from its header.
audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json records only resolved XY/Z values, not Leica XML identity or digest.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:11438-11486 demonstrates that the runtime requires this digest for manifest-locked organized filenames, but the corresponding retained run records are absent.
findings.recommendation: Archive the validated specimen manifest including calibration_metadata_sha256, plus each specimen's calibration_used.json and hashed microscope_metadata_used.xml. Verify path, hash, parsed dimensions, and resolved XY/Z values in an acceptance validator.

findings.title: Exact specimen settings and ordered source manifests are not retained
findings.impact: The repository evidence does not establish the complete image order, all Z/channel identities, applied exclusion mask, exact copied ROI, runtime environment, or settings files for the production run. External absolute paths and isolated hashes are insufficient for independent reproduction.
evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:11654-11866 implements a complete hashed settings bundle.

Repository inspection under audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate found none of the generated specimen settings_manifest.json, source_image_manifest.json, calibration_used.json, copied masks, or metadata XML files.
audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/tracking/tracking_replay_manifest.json references unretained external scratch CSV inputs and outputs.
findings.recommendation: Retain compact per-specimen settings bundles and frozen replay inputs, or package them as immutable release artifacts with repository-visible SHA-256 inventory and stable retrieval locations.

findings.title: Component evidence artifacts referenced by manifests are absent
findings.impact: The end-to-end PDF is retained, but the underlying stage and tracking images cannot be independently hashed against their manifests or reused for provenance inspection.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json names KJ-01_z035_stages.png and WT-01_z035_stages.png, but neither is present in the repository directory.
audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/end_to_end/end_to_end_visual_evidence_manifest.json references stage and tracking PNGs through external absolute paths.
Repository file listing showed only JSON manifests in the stages directory and tracking JSON/CSV metadata in the tracking directory.
findings.recommendation: Retain every component artifact named by an acceptance manifest and add an automated completeness-and-hash check.

limitations: No full image stack was run, as required.
Focused tests requiring pytest temporary files were not executed because the workspace permission profile is read-only; static test inspection and read-only hashing were used instead.
External source TIFFs, Leica XML files, ROI files, and scratch replay tables referenced by absolute paths were unavailable for independent rehashing.

An initial broad repository search inadvertently returned pre-existing reviewer JSON because Windows path separators defeated the exclusion glob. Those reviewer contents were excluded from this assessment; all stated evidence was independently inspected from source code, tests, validation receipts, and RC4 candidate artifacts.
recommended_follow_up: Create a superseding audit run after regenerating commit-matched manifests and validating their hashes automatically.
Archive the manifest-locked Leica XML digest and per-specimen calibration/settings bundles.
Retain the frozen tracking replay inputs and outputs with ordered source, Z, channel, ROI, exclusion-mask, profile, checkpoint, and environment provenance.
Add a repository test that fails when an evidence manifest names a missing artifact or records a pipeline/profile hash different from the reviewed commit.
